What Does The Name Aleyha Mean?
s: Aleyha is most commonly understood as a modern transliteration variant of the Arabic name Aliyah/Aaliyah (also spelled Aaliyah, Aliya, Aliyya), meaning “exalted,” “lofty,” or “ascending,” from the root ʿ-l-w (“to be high, to ascend”). In Hebrew, the cognate Aliyah signifies “ascent,” famously used for immigration to Israel and for being called up to the Torah.
